confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on 2026 aggregated cost-of-living guides (partly crowd-sourced) and are moderately reliable. The wine glass anchor has no direct price source and is set equal to the beer anchor. The cocktail anchor is a synthesized range from nightlife and cost guides. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Costa del Sol July pricing; no listings were inspected. EUR to USD uses an assumed rate of about 1.15, which is not sourced. The FX observation came from a search snippet dated 2026-03-20 and could not be confirmed as the latest RBA value for 2026-10-16, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Marbella's own 2026 cost-of-living figures were used for food and drink, with Costa del Sol and Costa Blanca guides as lower-bound checks. Accommodation uses general knowledge of Marbella summer pricing, with Puerto Banus and Golden Mile premiums considered.
